headline:
The rate cut everyone
was waiting for just
[[became a hike]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Plan around the rate you have, not the one you're hoping for.

stats.label: The Fed's first rate hike in three years, announced September 16, 2026.
The average South Florida mortgage rate right now, with lenders expecting 7 percent or higher by year end.
The Fed's own forecast pencils in one more hike this year, and none in 2027.
